manualFollowUps: After protected exact-head CI and merge, capture current migration history and apply only this ACL migration using supabase db push --linked from an isolated linked release. Its dry run must list exactly one pending migration. Never deploy the dirty primary checkout or unrelated proctor/importer migrations. No Edge Function or secret change is required.
verification: Require verify:prod, verify:release, full CI, 90-check PGlite/native installed-policy regression and captured full-schema role/ACL qualification. No customer records are read during capture. Verify shipped clients use the service API for the seven private tables.

After activation verify table and column ACLs from read-only metadata, then use an owned confirmed QA account and isolated Academy to prove raw reads denied and supported service API contacts/classrooms/staff reads remain available. Remove owned fixtures and erase login personal data through installed retention. Do not send messages or read real customer data.

rollback.pages: No frontend source changes. Automatic Pages builds remain commit tracked.
rollback.edge: No Edge source change or redeploy.
rollback.migration: Retain all records and schema. Prefer a scoped forward repair if a supported service flow fails; restoring broad browser ACLs reopens the proved peer-read exposure. A reviewed ACL restoration must use the captured exact prior table/column ACLs and protected release path.
